memory_candidates.content: When a doc-consistency-sweep task depends on a prior task that already edited some of the same files (e.g. task 817 before 818), locate edit sites by content/grep rather than trusting the research report's line numbers, even when the report claims to have re-verified them against disk — line numbers drift quickly across sequential doc-editing tasks touching the same file set. Re-grep the exact phrase from the plan/report before editing.

For account-generic (multi-account) documentation, prefer mirroring an authoritative per-account table (e.g. skill-email-cleanup/SKILL.md's 'Archive of record, per account' table with gmail ~64,000 / logos ~54 messages) into secondary docs rather than re-deriving or re-hardcoding the same figures independently. This keeps the numbers from drifting apart across files that describe the same underlying data.
